reproducibility_status: Source executes deterministic exact five-Bernoulli-state Gaussian integration using observed official Nikkei closes; local parameter-matched fixture test passed pre-commit. CI replay compares output against numeric checkpoints. Source values and checkpoint values are not fitted.
study_protocol: Use originally frozen five scenario Bernoulli probabilities and market Nikkei sigma 4.1% weekly, spread scenario mean over five independent Gaussian trading days, condition Monday and Tuesday simple returns, compute exact mixture normal-CDF tail over remaining three trading days. Separately keep prior scenario weights for a no-reweight benchmark and multiply volatility by 0.75/1/1.5/2. No new simulation paths and no model parameters fitted. Compare source date to cash-close time to avoid future-event leakage.
release_time_findings: RBA minutes released 09:30 JST before Tokyo close 15:30; UK ONS November labour release is 16:00 JST, after Tokyo close; US BLS Oct import/export 22:30 JST is after close and not yet available at study as-of. None supports causal attribution of today's Nikkei decline.

comparison_prior_hypotheses.outcome: Two-day conditioning changes model probabilities markedly, but latent Bernoulli state reweighting adds only 1.87 percentage points vs no-reweight after Tuesday; observed market return drives most shift. Model-conditional, not empirical winner evidence.
One of three named release clocks precedes Nov17 Nikkei cash close; no actual shock-response coefficient estimated. Explicit after-close sources excluded from same-day Tokyo attribution.

limitations: Local test uses identical parameters in isolated fixtures; repository CI full-path execution must pass to claim complete production replay.
The conditional result is computed AFTER Monday and Tuesday observed closes, not an original Saturday forecast, and cannot be counted as out-of-sample predictive skill.
Normal independent daily returns, equal 1/5 shock timing and Bernoulli latent shock interpretation are synthetic assumptions never empirically calibrated.
Returns compound across the two observed sessions and an approximate Gaussian sum covers remaining sessions; this is not a true fitted stochastic process.
UK unemployment LFS sample rotation, wage first-release/revision mismatch and October flash payroll uncertainty require provenance handling.
The UK labour release occurs after Tokyo close; RBA minutes are a delayed publication of November 3 monetary decision.
U.S. import/export October prices are NOT yet published at 19:16 JST, and no Nov20 weekly realized price or WTI fixed futures settlement is inserted.
